title: Checkpoint: append, rotate, replay
prompt:
Inside Solution, implement the journal over a temp directory you create in each call:
1. `static Path append(Path file, String event)` — appends `event + "\n"` in UTF-8
with CREATE + APPEND; returns the file.
2. `static List<String> replay(Path file)` — returns every complete line (a
TRUNCATED final line — one lacking its newline — must be dropped; use
Files.readString and split on "\n" carefully, or readAllLines and drop a final
fragment you detect by re-reading raw bytes).
3. `static Path rotate(Path file, int maxLines)` — if the file holds more than
maxLines complete lines, move it to a sibling named by appending ".1"
(file.1) atomically, and leave a fresh empty file at the original path; return
the ARCHIVE path (or the original if no rotation happened).
4. `static int countEvents(Path file)` — number of complete lines.

tests.name: append and replay
truncated tail is dropped
tests.hint: A torn tail never becomes an event.

tests.name: rotation by policy
tests.hint: History moved aside atomically; appends continue fresh.
